req/unknown-method: By design: Method is a closed tag union, so methods outside it (any token per RFC 9110 9.1) are rejected.
req/lowercase-method: By design: method names are case-sensitive (RFC 9110 9.1) and `get` is not in the Method union.
req/value-invalid-utf8: Field values are Str, so non-UTF-8 obs-text is rejected rather than decoded lossily (h11 keeps raw bytes).
req/obs-fold: RFC 9112 5.2 lets a server reject obs-fold with 400; this parser always rejects it (h11 unfolds it).
req/value-ctl: RFC 9110 5.5 field-value excludes CTLs; h11 only rejects NUL and whitespace controls. llhttp also rejects.
req/value-del: RFC 9110 5.5: DEL (0x7F) is not VCHAR or obs-text; h11 accepts it.
req/lf-line-endings: RFC 9112 2.2 only MAY accept bare LF; this parser requires CRLF (llhttp rejects bare LF by default; h11 accepts).
req/lf-final: As req/lf-line-endings: the empty line ending the head must be CRLF.
req/chunked-ext-bws: RFC 9112 7.1.1 allows BWS around ';' and '=' in chunk extensions; h11 does not.
req/chunked-trailing-space: RFC 9112 7.1 chunk-size line has no trailing whitespace; h11 tolerates trailing OWS.
req/chunked-ext-no-name: RFC 9112 7.1.1 requires a token after ';'; h11 accepts any chunk-ext text.
req/chunked-ext-bad-quote: RFC 9112 7.1.1 chunk-ext-val is token / quoted-string; h11 accepts any text.
req/chunked-trailer-obs-fold: Trailer fields follow field-line syntax; obs-fold is rejected as in the header section.
req/te-cl: RFC 9112 6.3 says a message with both ought to be handled as an error; llhttp rejects it by default, h11 lets Transfer-Encoding win.
req/te-http10: RFC 9112 6.1: Transfer-Encoding in an HTTP/1.0 message means the framing is faulty; h11 decodes it.
res/reason-ctl: RFC 9112 4 reason-phrase is HTAB / SP / VCHAR / obs-text; h11 accepts other controls.
res/101-unsolicited: h11 rejects a 101 the client did not ask for (connection state); as a message parser this library returns it with no body (RFC 9112 6.3 item 1).
